verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated risk product that claims to centralize risk processes and decisions in one platform (vanta-docs-48), with automated reminders and workflows for regular assessment, which approximates review cycles (vanta-docs-22). Its ISO 27001 module also offers AI templates covering risks (vanta-docs-39). The evidence never describes the register's actual structure. missing for 10: documented risk scoring/likelihood-impact, treatment plans, risk owners, explicit risk-to-control linkage, risk API endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
